passages.text: Most certainly I tell you, whoever will not receive God’s Kingdom like a little child, he will in no way enter into it.
passages.note: openness and trust like a child

passages.text: It is easier for a camel to go through a needle’s eye than for a rich man to enter into God’s Kingdom.
Whenever you stand praying, forgive, if you have anything against anyone; so that your Father, who is in heaven, may also forgive you your transgressions.
passages.note: holding a grudge; letting go through forgiveness
